sn22.64:1.2: ārāme. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.64:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu …pe… ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.64:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn22.64:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante maññamāno bandho mārassa
sn22.64:2.9: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.64:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.64:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu maññamāno bandho mārassa
sn22.64:3.10: imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti …pe…
sn22.64:3.11: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
